dialogue_texts: Reimu
What a bear that was over the past 24 hours.
Reimu
Starting a regular day, only to be informed by a youkai-born about the glohm...
Reimu
And now, heading to the Scarlet Devil Mansion to find Flandre, only to be met with nothing.
Reimu
At least I can relax until the festival kicks off...
Later that night...
Reimu
After a hard day and yesterday, I think it's time to call it a night.
Uhh, Your Honor?
Reimu
What's going on? Why have you returned?
You have to return to the Shirogane Manor.
Reimu
For real!? What has happened now?
Fusana's been glohmed again.
Reimu
I thought I contained this. Who's spreading it now?
No clue. While I was on the way to the shrine, I noticed some other individuals had been infected!
Reimu
I was just about to sleep, and now I have to continue my workout!? Let me grab a cup of coffee real quick.
This is so serious that I'm going with you this time.
Reimu
Only my danmaku serves as the antidote for this curse.
Exactly! There have been confirmed cases of human-to-human transmission.
Reimu
I'm experienced in this, so I don't have to get yelled at by a deity or a vampire.
To be continued in The Bewildering Parallel...
